_comment: Metal cannot be containerised, so this product is a build script, a run
script and this manifest. Everything the build needs is listed under
requires; nothing is installed, nothing is downloaded, and the run needs
The shaders are compiled at RUN time by Metal.framework from a string
inside the executable, because the target has Command Line Tools and no
Xcode, so xcrun metal is absent. That is why no .metal or .metallib file
appears here and why a shader fault would surface on the first run.

hardware.gpu: Apple silicon GPU exposed to Metal 3

toolchain.name: clang++
toolchain.why: compiles the Objective-C++ host; full Xcode is NOT required

frameworks.name: Metal
frameworks.why: device, queue, buffers, and the RUNTIME shader compiler

frameworks.name: Foundation
frameworks.why: NSString and NSError for the Metal API

python.used_by: skill/scripts/grade.sh only, never by the product
python.why: the check's own validate.py imports numpy

docker.used_by: skill/scripts/grade.sh only, to build the check image that produces the reference
docker.note: the target file records colima as the container runtime on this host

does_not_write_why: rubric.json lists these as bookkeeping that validate.py never opens; out999.dat is the incumbent's wall-clock backup dump, which fires only after 50 minutes of run time and cannot be reproduced by a port with a different clock. See skill/references/diary.md.

precision.state: double-single (a pair of fp32 giving ~48 significand bits)
precision.why: Metal Shading Language has no double type at all on this device
precision.fast_math: DISABLED at shader compile time; the error-free transformations this arithmetic is built from are algebraic no-ops that fast math deletes
